source: Anthropic Claude API first-party prices, checked against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-11-09. rightsize checks them every 30 days; run /rightsize prices to check sooner.
notes: window = the model's context window in tokens, from the Claude API models table (checked 2026-11-10). rightsize does not switch the main chat for a turn to a model whose window is smaller than the conversation. The price check keeps this field; a row without it is never held back.
haiku = Claude Haiku 5.5, sonnet = Claude Sonnet 5.5, opus = Claude Opus 5.5, fable = Claude Fable 5.2.

versions = older models, by ID without a date (claude-opus-4-8). rightsize prices a session on an older model by its row here; with no row, rightsize pauses on that model. The price check adds a row for every version the pricing page lists and keeps a row the page drops.

Cache writes are 1.25x input for the 5-minute cache and 2x for the 1-hour cache. rightsize reads which one a session writes from Claude Code's settings and environment and from the billing (1 hour on a subscription within its plan, 5 minutes otherwise; helpers always 5 minutes). Behind a gateway it cannot read, add "cacheTtl": "5m" or "1h" here to say so.

Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length. A request whose prompt (input, cache reads and cache writes together) is over 100K tokens pays the over100k prices: 0.50 input, 0.625 / 1.00 cache write (5m / 1h), 0.05 cache read, 2.50 output. Each request is priced on its own.
